Analyze all photographs in a prepared experiment

Source: R/workflow.R
run_experiment.Rd

Reads the editable project metadata, applies the fungal or control layout per row, writes QC images and saves measurements. Review flags are reset for this new analysis; coefficients are withheld until finish_experiment().

Usage

run_experiment(project, n_spots = NULL, spot_radius_mm = 0.5, ...)

Arguments

project

A funmel_project, its current folder, project.rds, or a saved analysis beside project.rds. Use load_experiment() after moving a project.

n_spots

Optional number of circular spots per target colony; NULL uses whole-colony pixels only. Spot and whole-colony results are kept separate.

spot_radius_mm

Radius of each optional circular ROI (mm).

...

Other analyze_plate() settings, such as dish_diameter_mm and max_dim.

Value

Batch result saved to image_analysis.rds and CSV tables.

Details

Dish diameter and any supplied pixel scale must be finite positive numeric scalars. Invalid settings stop before image processing or changes to project QC flags. Missing project metadata must be restored or its recorded path corrected. A batch with failed images saves error reports and warns; it does not report success. Inspect result$failed and resolve every failed image before finalization.
